title: Zero-drift regional traffic orchestrator with circuit-breaker roll-forward
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Harden the Hosted API deployment pipeline by implementing a regional-aware traffic orchestrator that performs progressive ramps with automatic circuit-breaker-based roll-forward and rollback. Goals: 1) Ensure zero-drift semantics across regions (no inconsistent model versions serving overlapping traffic windows), 2) Automate health and capacity checks (GPU availability, tail latency, error rate, cost delta) before traffic increases, 3) Provide explicit gating primitives tied to SLOs and rollback criteria, 4) Integrate with autoscaler and KV cache-warm path to avoid cold-start regressions.
comments: 2026-02-28 - Aisha Patel: Scoping doc created. Core idea is to combine phased traffic ramps with a circuit breaker that monitors a composite health metric (5xx rate, p99 latency, token-per-second throughput, and kv-cache miss rate). Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/RE/Regional+Orchestrator+Design

2026-03-03 - Marco Nguyen: Proof-of-concept controller daemon started. Uses leader-election per region via our existing control-plane leases. POC repos: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-orchestrator/tree/poc-cb

2026-03-05 - Design review notes (from PM and SRE): - Require explicit canary windows to be configurable per-customer tier - Add override for dedicated capacity customers to skip ramp if pinned model version - Ensure observability emits per-route 'serving-version' metric for drift detection

2026-03-07 - Marco Nguyen: Implemented composite health metric and circuit-breaker state machine. Started synthetic traffic tests against staging: observed KV-cache warming causing transient p95 regressions at 10% ramp. Mitigation: hold at 5% for 30s to warm cache before additional ramp.

2026-03-09 - SRE (Lena Ortiz): Load test summary uploaded. Findings: regional autoscaler lag led to queueing when ramp >20% in low-capacity regions. Action: integrate a preflight capacity check that queries Dedicated pool headroom and warns/blocks ramp if <30% buffer. Link to dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/rollout/region-orchestrator-loadtests

2026-03-11 - PM (Jared Kim): Updated release gating policy in Confluence. Added requirement for 'no new client errors' window of 5 minutes before moving past canary stage. Also added security review checklist. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/RE/Rollout+Gates+and+SLOs

2026-03-12 - Marco Nguyen: Created initial Runbook and rollback playbook. Added automated rollback trigger if composite health metric exceeds threshold for two consecutive window checks. PR for controller: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-orchestrator/pull/84 (needs SRE approval)

Follow-ups: - Add deterministic timestamp-based freeze to prevent cross-region version overlap during mid-rollouts - Add test scenario for mixed-hosted/dedicated customer routing - SRE to sign off on autoscaler integration before canary -> steady stages
